rationale: C25 is a clear reusable template for the child. Both are letters to the same Wage Stabilization Board chairman and use nearly verbatim language to certify a labor dispute based on advice from the same two agencies, refer it to the Board under the same executive order, and request investigation and recommendations for fair and equitable settlement. They then follow the same administrative sequence: describe the defense-production consequences, report the failure of negotiations or mediation, and address maintaining or restoring production while the dispute is before the Board. C02 and C20 are very similar earlier instances of the same template but are somewhat less close than C25 in addressee and presentation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: On the basis of the information and advice submitted to me by the Office of Defense Mobilization and the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, I am of the opinion that the labor disputes ... are of a character which substantially threaten the progress of national defense.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On the basis of the information and advice submitted to me by the Office of Defense Mobilization and the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service, I am of the opinion that the dispute ... is of a character which substantially threatens the progress of national defense.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim certification formula, with only the disputants and singular/plural grammar adapted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Thus, in accordance with the terms of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], I am referring the disputes to the Wage Stabilization Board and asking that the Board investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to me with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Thus, in accordance with the terms of E.O. 10233, I am referring the dispute to the Wage Stabilization Board and asking that the Board investigate and inquire into the issues in dispute and promptly report to me with its recommendations to the parties as to fair and equitable terms of settlement.
shared_material.explanation: The central operative referral and requested Board action are essentially identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service indicates that the union and the leading steel producers have made no progress in resolving their differences.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The report of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service indicates that negotiations to date have been unsuccessful and that, although full use has been made of mediation and conciliation facilities, the strike persists and is likely to persist.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the mediation service's report to establish that ordinary settlement efforts have failed before invoking the Board machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the parties to disputes in the steel industry owe it to the American people to cooperate with their government in maintaining normal work and production schedules while this matter is before the Board.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my earnest hope that the men involved will comply with your request that they return to work while the matter is before the Board and that the utilization of the Board's machinery will thus serve its purpose of restoring to production the facilities necessary to the national defense.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by urging continued or restored production during Board consideration, adapting the same functional closing to the steel dispute's pre-strike posture.
